# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: blocked — cited ruling is superseded

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:aea104d89bfefcc20ddc7fc7f60dd30e6ec3b20116f46fbde8b28e8997782b06

## Ruling check and task decision

Checked example/mira-decisions at commit
`1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c`.
The cited ADR 0002 file's bytes hash to
`sha256:aea104d89bfefcc20ddc7fc7f60dd30e6ec3b20116f46fbde8b28e8997782b06`,
matching the reference. Its Status is `Superseded by 0014`, so it is not in force.
At the same commit, ADR 0014 (`docs/adr/0014-reports-go-out-daily.md`) is
`Superseded by 0023`. ADR 0023
(`docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md`) is `Accepted` and sets the
report job to run daily at 07:00 shop time.

Choice: `none`; action: stop. The read-ruling skill requires stopping when the
cited ruling is not Accepted, even when its digest matches. The task's ruling
reference needs to be reconciled with the accepted successor before proceeding.
This records a task-level stop, not a change to the report-cadence ruling.

Scope: decide and record only; do not implement the feature or commit, push, or
merge changes. No implementation changes were made.
